policy_note: Controlled thematic taxonomy for the Gong'an index. Every entry in data/gongan/gongan_index.json must carry a theme_group key from this list (enforced by validate_data.py). The per-entry `theme` string remains the rich, case-specific descriptor and is still displayed on cards; the index filter chips are generated from these groups (with counts), so chips group cases meaningfully instead of listing 23 one-off labels. Extend this file first when a genuinely new thematic family appears.

themes.note: The ground of awakening: dog's Buddha-nature, face before good/evil, flag and wind as mind-only.
Cases that cut off the dualistic intellect: vast emptiness, 'the Way is not difficult', the cat cut in two, neither cold nor heat.

themes.display: The Ultimate Question: What is Buddha? (如何是佛)
themes.note: Cases circling the defining question of the tradition: three pounds of hemp, dried dung, the cypress tree, the living master's four gates.

themes.display: Direct Pointing at the Person (直指汝是)
themes.note: Cases where the master points at the questioner or the concrete particular: one finger, 'You are Huichao', 'seen through!', the whole earth as a grain of millet.
Awakening in ordinary activity and circumstances: washing the bowl, ordinary mind, sun-faced/moon-faced Buddha, every day is a good day.
Dharma order and lineage: the flower sermon that founded wordless transmission, and the wild fox's five hundred lives on cause and effect.
The life-and-death urgency where words fail: Xiangyan up a tree.
